Standout individual stocks表现突出的个股 120 shown ·已显示 · 217 fully aligned across weekly · 3-day · daily (bottoming, not a falling knife) · TWO gauges per card: an OWN-IT conviction score (leadership · quality · valuation) and a separate ENTRY gauge — buy now, or wait for the pullback to $X. A high score is NOT a buy-now; the green dot means the entry is open today.在周线·3日·日线上完全共振（筑底，而非接飞刀）· 每张卡片两个量表：持有信念分（领先·质量·估值）+ 独立的入场量表 — 立即买入，或等待回撤至某价位。高分并不等于立即买入；绿点代表今日入场窗口已开。 ?Each name carries TWO independent gauges so a great company is never confused with a great entry. (1) OWN-IT CONVICTION (the 0-100 score): leadership (validated sector-neutral residual momentum α across the S&P 1500) + quality + a forward-aware valuation read — a cheap-on-forward leader like NVDA is NOT penalized for a rich trailing multiple. It surfaces leaders that aren't in any sector ETF's top-10. It is a within-market percentile DISPLAY skin (not a probability) and reads 'high-confluence (context)' until a deep Phase-0 proves forward edge; the α leg is just one light, regime-scaled input, not the rank key. (2) ENTRY TIMING (the coloured strip): the price-cycle read across daily/3-day/weekly — buy now (green dot), wait for the pullback to the shown buy-zone price, or extended/topping (don't chase). Two VERIFIERS — an Options (dealer-gamma) check and a single-stock volatility-squeeze read — sharpen the ENTRY only (display + a small bounded tilt); they can lower conviction but never manufacture a buy, and never touch the selection rank. The price-cycle state is a HARD modifier: a name late in its cycle, in a downtrend or topping, can NEVER read 'buy now' — it reads 'strong name, wrong tape', which is why this card and the stock's own page never disagree. The board is sorted by conviction; the entry gauge tells you which are actionable today. Click any card for the full breakdown.每个标的带有两个相互独立的量表，使“好公司”绝不等同于“好入场点”。(1) 持有信念（0-100 分）：领先度（在标普1500内已验证的行业中性残差动量 α）+ 质量 + 前瞻估值读数——像 NVDA 这种前瞻便宜的领涨股不会因偏高的历史倍数而被扣分。它能发掘不在任何行业ETF前十大持仓中的领涨股。它是市场内百分位的展示皮肤（非概率），在深度 Phase-0 证明前瞻优势前显示为“高共振（参考）”；α 维度只是一个轻量、随行情缩放的输入，并非排序关键。(2) 入场择时（彩色条）：跨日线/3日/周线的价格周期读数——立即买入（绿点）、等待回撤至所示买入区价位，或过度拉伸/做顶（勿追高）。两个验证器——期权（做市商 Gamma）检查与个股波动压缩读数——只优化“入场”（展示＋小幅有界倾斜）；它们可降低确信度，但绝不制造买入信号，也不触及选股排序。价格周期状态是硬性修正项：处于周期晚期、下行或做顶的个股永远不会显示“立即买入”，而显示“强势但趋势不利”，因此本卡片与个股自身页面绝不冲突。榜单按信念排序；入场量表告诉你今天哪些可操作。点击任意卡片查看完整拆解。
Reading the cards如何看卡片 Score评分 = within-board percentile RANK (today’s board), not an absolute 0–100 — the verdict is the absolute read.板内百分位排名（今日榜单），并非绝对 0–100 — 结论才是绝对读数。 ·Edge basis优势来源: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

⚠ Cycle-timing signals are about where in the price cycle a sector is — most useful combined with the regime read above. Our calibration shows these states don't beat buy-and-hold on average return; their value is structure and risk placement (entry + a defined exit), not certainty.周期择时信号关乎一个板块处于价格周期的哪个位置 — 与上方的周期判读结合使用最有价值。我们的校准显示这些状态在平均回报上并不能跑赢买入持有；它们的价值在于结构与风险摆位（入场 + 明确的出场），而非确定性。

Regime-approved sectors — leaders & avoids周期认可的板块 — 领先与回避 ?Sector calls derived from the current regime. Confirmed leadership = an established uptrend with positive, not-yet-stretched momentum. Avoids = the evidence-backed don'ts (chasing stretched leaders and buying below-trend bounces both lost in our 2007-2026 backtest).源自当前周期的板块判断。已确认领先＝既定上涨趋势、动量为正且尚未过热。回避＝有证据支撑的禁忌（追逐过热领先股与买入趋势下方反弹在 2007–2026 回测中都亏钱）。

✅ Confirmed leadership — where participation is real已确认的领先 — 参与度真实之处 ?Sectors in an established uptrend vs the market with momentum still positive and not yet stretched. Descriptive — where the market's money already is. Use it to place exposure you already intend to take.相对市场处于既定上涨趋势、动量仍为正且尚未过度拉伸的板块。这是描述性的 — 市场资金已经在哪里。用它来摆放你本就打算建立的敞口。

LEADER领先 XLI · Industrials工业
Established uptrend vs the market, short-term momentum positive (+5.2% vs the market this month; rebuilding after a soft 3 months (-2.9%)). Tech: RSI 56, above both moving averages. Jun: -0.4% avg, up 46% of years (n=28).相对市场已确立上涨趋势，短期动量为正 （本月相对市场 +5.2%；在疲软的 3 个月后重建中（-2.9%））。 技术面：RSI 56、位于两条均线之上。 6月：平均 -0.4%，46% 的年份上涨（n=28）。

Longer-horizon tilt:较长时间尺度倾斜： XLK, XLI, XLE ?Top-3 by 12-month relative momentum — the only sector tilt with a persistent (if mild) historical edge: +0.27% avg vs SPY over ~6 months, 51.0% hit rate. Small caps (Russell 2000) and mid caps measured against the large-cap S&P 500: rising = participation broadening (risk-on); falling = a narrow, mega-cap-led tape. Market breadth — how many stocks are actually participating市场广度 — 究竟有多少股票在参与 ?Breadth across the full S&P Composite 1500 (large = S&P 500, mid = S&P 400, small = S&P 600): how many stocks are advancing, how many hold above their 50- and 200-day lines, and net new 52-week highs. A strong index riding on a shrinking number of stocks is fragile — broad participation confirms a move, thinning breadth is an early warning. The % above the 50-day line also feeds the regime model's growth axis, so this is the same breadth the model reads, just made legible.覆盖整个标普综合 1500（大盘 = 标普500、中盘 = 标普400、小盘 = 标普600）的广度：多少股票上涨、多少守在其 50 日与 200 日均线之上，以及净创 52 周新高。指数走强却只靠越来越少的股票支撑则脆弱 — 广泛参与确认走势，广度变薄是早期预警。高于 50 日线的占比也进入周期模型的增长轴，因此这与模型读取的是同一广度，只是更直观。

Advanced breadth — the market internals under the tape高级广度 — 盘面之下的市场内部结构 ?The classic 'market internals' a desk watches beyond today's %-above-MA snapshot: the McClellan Oscillator & Summation Index (breadth momentum), the Zweig Breadth Thrust gauge, the High-Low Index, whether the advance/decline line confirms price, and where participation sits in its own multi-decade history. Computed on the DEEP S&P 500 breadth series (1962-). These are SECOND-DERIVATIVE reads of the same breadth — they describe the QUALITY of the move (broad vs narrow, accelerating vs rolling over). Display-only: breadth internals are a function of price, so they're coincident with it by construction — this explains the tape, it does not forecast it. Survivorship caveat: the deep series is rebuilt from today's members, so the percentile context is taken over the mature-universe window only.盘面之下、超越「高于均线占比」快照的经典「市场内部结构」：麦克莱伦振荡指标与累积指标（广度动量）、兹威格广度脉冲、新高—新低指数、腾落线是否确认价格，以及当前参与度在其数十年历史中的分位。基于标普500深度广度序列（1962年起）计算。这些是同一广度的二阶读数 — 描述走势的「质量」（广泛或狭窄、加速或回落）。仅作展示：内部结构是价格的函数、与价格同步，用于解释盘面而非预测。幸存者偏差提示：深度序列以当前成分股重建，故分位背景仅取成熟样本区间。

The internals read内部结构读数为 firm稳健 — the internals are confirming the tape — broad participation and positive momentum内部结构在确认盘面 — 参与广泛、动量为正.

McClellan Oscillator麦克莱伦振荡指标 ?Ratio-adjusted McClellan Oscillator: the 19-day minus 39-day EMA of net advances (normalised so a changing universe size doesn't distort it). Above zero & rising = breadth momentum building; below zero & falling = internals rolling over. The Summation Index is its running total — its slope and sign carry the meaning, not the absolute (cumulative) level.比率调整后的麦克莱伦振荡指标：净上涨家数的19日与39日指数均线之差（已归一化，避免样本规模变化造成失真）。高于零且上行 = 广度动量在累积；低于零且下行 = 内部结构在回落。累积指标是其累计和 — 关键在斜率与正负号，而非绝对（累计）水平。

Breadth Thrust (Zweig)广度脉冲（兹威格） ?The 10-day EMA of the advancers' share, advances / (advances + declines). Zweig's classic launch signal fires when it surges from below 0.40 (washed out) through 0.615 (thrust) inside 10 days — a rare, powerful 'everything's going up at once' kick-off. HONESTY: on our survivorship-biased S&P-500 proxy the strict crossing fires far more often than the canonical ~once-a-decade NYSE signal (rebuilt-from-survivors rebounds look broader than they were live), so read this as a momentum gauge, not the rare historic trigger.上涨家数占比（上涨 /(上涨+下跌)）的10日指数均线。兹威格的经典启动信号：在10日内自0.40以下（超卖）急升突破0.615（脉冲）时触发 —— 罕见而强劲的「同涨」启动。诚实说明：在带有幸存者偏差的标普500代理上，严格的穿越远比经典的纽交所「十年一遇」信号更频繁（以幸存者重建的反弹看起来比当时更广），故此处作为动量计读取，而非罕见的历史触发。

High-Low Index新高—新低指数 ?The 10-day average of the record-high percent: 52-week new highs as a share of (new highs + new lows). Above 50 = new highs are outpacing new lows (an expanding, healthy new-high ledger); below 50 = the new-low side is winning (deterioration). A/D line vs price腾落线对价格 ?Does the cumulative advance/decline line confirm the index's recent extremes? If price prints a fresh 3-month high the A/D line will NOT confirm, the advance is narrowing underneath (bearish divergence); a fresh price low the A/D line refuses to confirm is a bullish divergence. Otherwise the internals are confirming the move, or nothing is at an extreme (in range). The sparkline traces the A/D line; the correlation is price-vs-A/D over the last 60 sessions.累积腾落线是否确认指数近期的极值？若价格创3个月新高而腾落线未确认，则上涨在底层收窄（看跌背离）；若价格创新低而腾落线拒绝确认，则为看涨背离。否则即为内部结构确认走势，或均未触及极值（区间内）。曲线描绘腾落线；相关系数为近60个交易日价格与腾落线的相关性。

Sector Bottom Radar — washout durability, not rotation板块见底雷达 — 错杀的持久性，而非轮动 ?The buy-side complement to the heat board below. It runs the SAME validated 'Bottom Confidence' score we compute per stock (walk-forward calibrated monotone on 69k evals) on each sector ETF: how DURABLE a washing-out sector's low looks — high = the kind of selloff whose low has historically held with a SHALLOWER drawdown — discounted when the turn isn't confirmed on the weekly/monthly and when price is a deep falling-knife below its 200-day. The whole board is then conditioned by the index Fed-put gate: in a put-absent regime (recession or inflation-locked Fed) the same washout signals kept falling in 2000/2008/2022. This is a RISK / DURABILITY read, NOT a return forecast and NOT alpha — it trades some of the explosive bounce for a much higher chance the low holds. The heat board describes what's already hot (and late); this finds where a durable low may be forming. Validated in research/SECTOR_BOTTOM_RADAR.md.下方热度榜的买方补充。它在每个板块 ETF 上运行与个股相同的、经验证的「见底信心」分数（经 6.9 万次步进式校准、单调有效）：衡量一个正被错杀的板块其低点有多持久——分数越高，代表这类抛售的低点历史上更易守住、回撤更浅——当周线／月线尚未确认转向、或价格深跌破 200 日线（接飞刀）时会打折。整个看板再由指数层面的美联储托底闸门来条件化：在托底缺位（衰退或通胀锁死）的格局下，同类超卖信号在 2000／2008／2022 年持续下跌。这是风险／持久性读数，并非收益预测、也非超额收益——它以让出部分爆发式反弹，换取低点守住的更高概率。热度榜描述的是已经火热（且偏晚）的板块；本雷达则寻找可能正在形成的持久低点。验证见 research/SECTOR_BOTTOM_RADAR.md。

Macro gate宏观闸门: Index Fed-put is INTACT — buyable-washout regime. Sector lows that score well are favoured to hold with a shallower drawdown; confirm into stabilization, don't anticipate.指数层面美联储托底仍在——可买入错杀格局。评分较高的板块低点更倾向于守住且回撤更浅；确认企稳后再介入，勿抢跑。

sector板块 bottom confidence见底信心 ? Bottom Confidence 0-100 — how durable, low-drawdown this sector's low looks. Measured (sector ETFs, 1998-2026): sectors scoring 60+ held their cycle low ~79% of the time vs ~34% at 0-20, with a shallower drawdown tail. Higher = a more durable low, not a bigger bounce (the deepest washouts bounce hardest but rarely hold). Risk/durability, never a return forecast. 见底信心 0-100 — 衡量该板块的低点有多持久、回撤有多浅。实测（板块 ETF，1998-2026）：得分 60+ 的板块约 79% 守住其周期低点，而 0-20 区间仅约 34%，且回撤尾部更浅。分数越高代表低点越持久，而非反弹更大（最深的错杀反弹最猛，却很少守住）。这是风险／持久性，绝非收益预测。 verdict判定 members washed / turning成分股超卖／转向 ?Live breadth confirmer: of the sector's S&P 500 members, the share below their 200-day (washed out) and, of those, the share reclaiming their 10-day (turning up). Sector heat board — regime × tape × technicals × seasonality板块热度榜 — 周期 × 盘面 × 技术 × 季节性 ?One row per sector, everything that matters in one place. HEAT (0-100) measures how CONFIRMED a sector's strength is right now: regime fit + rotation stage + technicals, minus crowding. Important: heat describes the present, not the future — our 2007-2026 backtest shows the hottest band (70+) actually UNDERPERFORMED over the following months (everything-confirmed usually means late). So: high heat = hold/trim territory, never a fresh-entry signal; the buy workflow is the watchlist + trigger column.每个板块一行，把重要的一切放在一处。热度（0–100）衡量一个板块的强势此刻有多被确认：周期契合度 + 轮动阶段 + 技术面，减去拥挤度。重要：热度描述的是现在，而非未来 — 我们 2007–2026 的回测显示最热的区间（70+）在随后几个月反而跑输（万事俱备通常意味着已晚）。因此：高热度 = 持有／减仓区，绝非新建仓信号；买入流程靠观察名单 + 触发列。

sector板块 heat热度 ? Heat = how CONFIRMED a sector's strength is (regime fit + trend stage + technicals − crowding − a macro-risk adjustment when macro risk is elevated and the sector is macro-sensitive). Hover each bar for its exact arithmetic.

*vs the index, every week 2007-2026. Note the inversion: hot sectors were usually LATE. That measured record is the trust level — and it argues against chasing. 热度 = 一个板块的强势有多被确认（周期契合度 + 趋势阶段 + 技术面 − 拥挤度 − 宏观风险升高且板块对宏观敏感时的宏观风险调整）。 将鼠标悬停在每个条上可查看其精确算式。
区间解读为实测 3 个月记录*
70+ 过热已晚 — 持有／减仓，勿入场跑赢市场 47%（平均 −0.6%）
55-69 偏热已确认 — 持有，回调时买入49%（−0.3%）

*对比指数，2007–2026 每一周。注意这种反转：偏热的板块通常都已晚。 这份实测记录就是可信度 — 它反对追高。 		stage阶段 ? The rotation cycle — every sector travels this loop vs the market: 1. IMPROVING — momentum turns up, trend not yet confirmed. Too early: buying here lost money historically. 2. LEADING — confirmed uptrend. The healthy zone. 3. WEAKENING — still above trend but losing steam. Tighten stops. 4. LAGGING — downtrend. Avoid until it improves again. 轮动周期 — 每个板块相对市场都会走完这个循环： 1. 改善 — 动量转上，趋势尚未确认。过早：历史上在这里买入会亏钱。 2. 领先 — 已确认上涨趋势。健康区。 3. 走弱 — 仍在趋势上方但动能减弱。收紧止损。 4. 落后 — 下跌趋势。回避，直到再度改善。 3mo vs market3 月对比市场 ?How much it beat or trailed the S&P 500 over the past 60 trading days — the medium-term relative trend the playbook keys off.过去 60 个交易日内它跑赢或落后标普 500 多少 — 剧本所依据的中期相对趋势。 technicals技术面 ? RSI(14) — a 0-100 momentum thermometer: OVERSOLD SOFT HEALTHY HOT 0304570100 ✓/✗ 200d and 50d: whether price is above its 200-day (long-term) and 50-day (medium-term) average — the most basic "is it in an uptrend" filters. Green row = both ✓. RSI(14) — 一个 0–100 的动量温度计： 超卖 疲软 健康 过热 0304570100 ✓/✗ 200日 与 50日：价格是否高于其 200 日（长期）与 50 日（中期）均线 — 最基本的"是否处于上涨趋势"过滤器。 绿色行 = 两者皆 ✓。 seasonality季节性 ?This sector's average return in the current calendar month (and how often that month closed up). Hover any value for the full 12-month picture — a chart plus a table, with this month highlighted. Weak evidence by nature: background context only, never a signal on its own, and deliberately left out of the heat score.该板块在当前日历月的平均回报（以及该月收涨的频率）。将鼠标悬停在任意数值上可查看完整的 12 个月全貌 — 图表加表格，并高亮当前月份。本质上是弱证据：仅作背景参考，绝不单独作为信号，并已刻意排除在热度分数之外。 to trigger距触发 ?For sectors below their long-term relative trend: how much more outperformance vs SPY is needed for the trend to cross (= the data-backed buy confirmation), and how far along it already is from its recent low. Small gap + high progress = watch closely.对于低于其长期相对趋势的板块：还需相对 SPY 多跑赢多少趋势才会交叉（= 有数据支撑的买入确认），以及从近期低点起已走了多远。差距小 + 进度高 = 密切观察。 cycle timing周期择时 ?From the sector's own price cycle (click the sector name for the full drill-down): where it sits in its ~36-42 trading-day cycle and how many of its top-10 holdings are in a buy setup (BOTTOMING or BUY ZONE). 🐳 Accumulation watch — sector ETFs🐳 增持监测 — 板块 ETF ?Each sector SPDR's top-10 weights, with each holding's weight change split into the part explained by the stock's own price move and a residual ('active' = weight that grew MORE than price alone). A large positive residual = real buying flowed into the name beyond market drift. HONEST CAVEAT: these SPDRs are PASSIVE index funds, so the residual is index reconstitution / float-weight flow (forced index-fund buying), NOT a discretionary manager's conviction — that reading comes with the active funds in the planned top-200 page. The technical column shows the stock's own cycle state; ✅ marks accumulation that also has a forming buy setup. Thresholds are uncalibrated until more snapshot history accumulates.每只板块 SPDR 的前十大权重；每只持仓的权重变动被拆分为“由个股自身价格变动解释的部分”与“残差”（“主动”=权重增长超过价格涨幅的部分）。较大的正残差=除市场漂移外确有真实买盘流入该股。诚实提示：这些 SPDR 是被动指数基金，故残差代表指数再平衡／流通权重调整带来的资金流（被动强制买入），并非主动经理的信念——后者要等到计划中的前 200 ETF 页面里的主动基金。技术面列显示个股自身的周期状态；✅ 表示增持同时出现了正在形成的买入形态。在积累更多快照历史前，阈值尚未校准。

“Active Δwt” strips out price: it is the percentage points of weight a name gained beyond what its own price move explains. On passive index ETFs this captures index reconstitution / float-weight flow, not a manager’s discretion. The estimated $ flow applies the active Δwt to the fund’s AUM and is approximate.“主动权重Δ”已剔除价格因素：它是个股权重增长中超出其自身价格涨幅所能解释的百分点。在被动指数 ETF 上，这反映的是指数再平衡／流通权重调整带来的资金流，而非经理人的主动决策。估算的美元资金流是将“主动权重Δ”乘以基金 AUM 得出的近似值。

Real fund moves — strongest conviction基金真实动作 — 信念最强 ?The top conviction-ranked ACCUMULATION decisions across curated thematic/industry funds (SPDR sector, Global X) and actively managed funds (ARK), with mechanical flow AND price moves stripped out. Conviction = percentage POINTS of fund weight the manager actually committed — so a real add to a meaningful position outranks a tiny position doubling. The full board (incl. trims & every fund) is the 🐳 Real fund moves page.在精选的主题／行业基金（SPDR 板块、Global X）与主动管理基金（ARK）中，按信念排序的最强增持决策，已剔除机械性资金流与价格变动。信念 = 经理人实际投入的基金权重百分点——因此对有意义仓位的真实增持会胜过微小仓位的翻倍。完整看板（含减持与全部基金）见 🐳 基金真实动作 页面。 see all →查看全部 →
